classdef Export
methods(Static)
function tables(file)
 o=jog2.Store.metadata(file);folder=fullfile(fileparts(file),'tables');if ~exist(folder,'dir'),mkdir(folder);end
 rows={};
 for c=1:numel(o.summaries)
  s=o.summaries{c};if isempty(s),continue;end
  for m=1:numel(s.method)
   a=s.method{m};q=find(a.blocks.full.nominal==.95);
   rows(end+1,:)={s.run_id,s.suite,s.spec.condition_id,s.spec.sweep,s.spec.n,s.spec.depth_spread,...
    s.spec.noise_scale,s.spec.geometry_id,a.label,a.n_total,a.n_valid,...
    a.blocks.position.scatter,a.blocks.position.predicted_scatter,a.blocks.position.rmse,...
    a.blocks.position.coverage_conditional(q),a.blocks.eop.coverage_conditional(q),...
    a.blocks.full.coverage_conditional(q),a.blocks.full.coverage_operational(q),...
    a.blocks.full.nees_mean,a.remainder.normalized_rms,a.variance_factor.mean,a.variance_factor.rejection_rate};
  end
 end
 names={'run_id','suite','condition_id','sweep','n','depth_full_width','noise_std_multiplier','geometry_id',...
 'method','maps_attempted','fits_valid','empirical_position_scatter_m','predicted_position_scatter_m',...
 'position_rmse_m','position_coverage95','eop_coverage95','full_coverage95','operational_full_coverage95',...
 'full_nees_mean','normalized_remainder_rms','variance_factor_mean','global_test_rejection'};
 if ~isempty(rows),writetable(cell2table(rows,'VariableNames',names),fullfile(folder,'condition_summary.csv'));end
 f=fopen(fullfile(folder,'definitions.json'),'w');cl=onCleanup(@()fclose(f));
 fprintf(f,'%s',jsonencode(struct('scatter','sqrt(trace(centered sample covariance))',...
 'predicted_scatter','sqrt(trace(mean reported covariance))','coverage','conditional on valid covariance unless operational',...
 'variance_factor','2*cost/(2*n-10); never used to rescale covariance',...
 'nonlinear_remainder','valid-fit RMS whitened by true sampling covariance at this epsilon',...
 'target_coverage','pointwise chi2_2; exact plane and independent exact checkpoints'),PrettyPrint=true));
end
end
end

classdef Import
methods(Static)
function b=batch(old,ix,d,cfg)
 % Obtain the exact v2 shape without running an estimator or RNG.
 n=d.spec.n;N=numel(ix);M=numel(d.methods);
 b=struct('trial_id',old.trial_id(ix),'observations',old.observations(:,:,ix),...
 'local_errors',old.true_local_errors(:,ix),'common_effects',old.true_common_effects(:,ix),...
 'eta',zeros(5*n,N),'z_local',zeros(5*n,N),'z_common',zeros(size(old.true_common_effects,1),N),...
 'rng_id',repmat(old.seed(ix),2,1),'errors',nan(10,N,M),'covariance_common',nan(10,10,N,M),...
 'covariance_native',nan(10,10,N,M),'valid',false(M,N),'linear_error',nan(10,N,M),...
 'cameras',nan(16,M,N),'cost',nan(M,N),'iterations',zeros(M,N),'closure',nan(M,N),...
 'stationarity',nan(M,N),'physical',false(M,N),'active_bound',false(M,N),'rank',nan(M,N),...
 'condition_scaled',nan(M,N),'elapsed',nan(M,N),'selected_candidate',zeros(M,N),...
 'reprojection',nan(2,n,M,N),'adjusted',nan(5,n,M,N),'correction',nan(5,n,M,N),...
 'sensitivity',nan(10,5*n,M,N),'latent_values',zeros(0,1),'latent_offset',zeros(2,M,N),...
 'history_values',zeros(0,7),'history_offset',zeros(2,M,N),...
 'candidate_camera',zeros(16,0),'candidate_info',zeros(9,0),'candidate_history',zeros(0,7),...
 'candidate_history_offset',zeros(2,0),'initializer_camera',zeros(16,0),'initializer_trial',zeros(1,0),...
 'status_code',zeros(M,N),'candidate_status_code',zeros(1,0),...
 'meta',struct('status_dictionary',{{}},'error_messages',{{}},...
 'candidate_physical_available',false,'primitive_normals_provenance','reconstructed from stored errors and original Cholesky factors'));
 b.eta=b.local_errors+d.noise_model.G_raw*b.common_effects;
 b.z_local=d.noise_model.F_local\b.local_errors;b.z_common=chol(d.noise_model.Q_b,'lower')\b.common_effects;
 for kk=1:N
  k=ix(kk);pool=old.shared_initializer_pool{k};
  for p=1:numel(pool),b.initializer_camera(:,end+1)=jog2.Util.camvec(pool{p});b.initializer_trial(end+1)=k;end
  for m=1:M
   r=old.runs{m,k};b=jog2.Batch.addFit(b,r,m,kk,d.geometry.truth_camera);
   b.linear_error(:,kk,m)=d.oracle_reference{m}.sensitivity*b.eta(:,kk);
  end
 end
 % Preserve original arrays rather than rounding through recomputation.
 b.errors=old.errors(:,ix,:);b.covariance_native=old.covariance_at_estimate(:,:,ix,:);
 b.covariance_common=old.covariance_common(:,:,ix,:);
end
end
end
